rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site/multi-scanner cohorts; ADNI Phase 3 uses seven acquisition protocols and NIMHANS includes two scanners.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "In total, we analyzed diffusion data of 1032 subjects from two cohorts - 730 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) Phase 3 collected using seven acquisition protocols and an independent sample of 302 Indian-ancestry participants, evaluated and scanned at two scanners at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) in Bangalore, India."

rci2_using_epd.detail: ADNI is used as a reference cohort component for normative modeling.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Data used in preparation of this article were obtained from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) database (adni.loni.usc.edu)."

rci3_epd_name.detail: ADNI Phase 3 diffusion data used in this study.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We analyzed dMRI data from Phase 3 of ADNI, which recently concluded, from 730 participants, collected using seven acquisition protocols..."

rci5_n.detail: Normative modelの構築において、「正常」の定義を学習するために直接用いられた訓練データ（Train段階）の合計は、事前学習の**198名**と、ターゲット解析でのファインチューニングに用いられた**約199名**を合わせた人数となる。
rci5_n.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.2.3 TractoInferno, L128; Methods / 2.1 Participant demographics, L77; Methods / 2.3.2 Data preparation and training, L168

rci6_sex.detail: model-1: TractoInferno demographics (including sex) referred to external source Poulin et al. 2022 (Scientific Data); model-2 and model-3: Table 1 in the paper reports Male (%) for entire protocol samples (CN + MCI + dementia combined), not for CN-only training splits; CN-specific sex breakdown for ADNI and NIMHANS training splits is not separately reported
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "All participants in the TractoInferno are healthy adults. Demographics including age and sex are available elsewhere." [Poulin et al. 2022]; Table 1 reports Male (%) for total N per protocol (CN + MCI + dementia combined)

rci7_age.detail: model-1: TractoInferno demographics (including age) referred to external source Poulin et al. 2022 (Scientific Data); model-2 and model-3: Table 1 reports Age (Mean ± SD) for total N per protocol (CN + MCI + dementia combined); ADNI Total = 74.13 ± 7.93, NIMHANS Total = 67.25 ± 7.86, but these are not CN-specific training split values; CN-only age statistics for the training splits are not separately reported
rci7_age.supporting_text: "All participants in the TractoInferno are healthy adults. Demographics including age and sex are available elsewhere." [Poulin et al. 2022]; Table 1 Age(Mean ± SD) for ADNI Total: 74.13 ± 7.93, NIMHANS Total: 67.25 ± 7.86
